title: Login crashes when auth token is missing
description: Submitting the login form without an auth token crashes because validate_token calls strip on None.
logs:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "src/auth/session.py", line 5, in start_session
    token = validate_token(user.token)
  File "src/auth/validator.py", line 2, in validate_token
    return token.strip()
TypeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'strip'
steps_to_reproduce: Submit the login form without an auth token.
expected_behavior: The application should show a validation error for a missing token.
actual_behavior: The login flow crashes with a TypeError.

title: Password reset request never sends email
description: When a user requests a password reset, the flow builds a reset message but no reset email is delivered. The report mentions password reset email delivery but does not include a stack trace.
steps_to_reproduce: Request a password reset for an existing user.
expected_behavior: A password reset email should be sent.
actual_behavior: The request completes but no email is sent.

title: Authentication behavior feels inconsistent
description: A tester reports that authentication sometimes behaves oddly after several actions. There is no stack trace, no exact error message, and no file or function name in the report.
steps_to_reproduce: Use the authentication flow for several minutes.
actual_behavior: The tester could not identify a precise failure point.

title: Session refresh expires too early because default auth setting is wrong
description: The session refresh flow uses the default auth timeout and expires active users too early. Please inspect src/auth/settings.py and DEFAULT_SESSION_TTL before changing session code.
steps_to_reproduce: Wait less than the expected timeout.
expected_behavior: The session remains active until the configured timeout.
actual_behavior: The session is treated as expired too early.
